School.title: School
School.description: Shared school workspace holding authorized member UIDs for the 24-classroom monitor.

name.description: Display name of the school building.

memberUids.description: UIDs of authenticated Google users belonging to this school.

createdByUid.description: UID of the user who initialized the school workspace.

ClassroomRoom.title: ClassroomRoom
ClassroomRoom.description: State of one of the 24 classrooms (3 floors x 8 classes) including daily absences, Period 1-2 hygiene report, and 8 room devices.

roomCode.description: Physical room number such as P.101 or P.308.

memberUids.description: Denormalized member UIDs matching the parent school.

reportDate.description: Date string YYYY-MM-DD for daily absence and hygiene reset.

absences.description: Bounded list of absent students with absenceType and reason.

hygieneTimeText.description: HH:mm timestamp text when hygiene report was submitted.

hygieneOnTime.description: Whether the hygiene inspection occurred during 07:00-08:35.

hygieneNote.description: Notes from the duty student team.

hygieneFloorClean.description: Checklist item: floor and hallway clean.

hygieneBoardClean.description: Checklist item: board wiped and desks aligned.

devices.description: Status map (GOOD or BROKEN) for lamp1..4, fan1..2, tv, wifi.

deviceConfirmedBy.description: Monitor account label confirming device state, or empty if unconfirmed.

deviceConfirmedAtText.description: HH:mm time when class monitor confirmed device status.

rolePin.description: 4-digit role PIN for quick class verification.

rolePattern.description: Dash-delimited 3x3 Android pattern sequence for quick class verification.

updatedByUid.description: UID of the authenticated Google user who last wrote this document.

/schools/{schoolId}.description: School workspace metadata and authorized member UIDs.
